reviewer.scope: Markdown and fragment suites, captures 1, 2, and 3; read-only review of frozen records and snapshots

calibration.comparison_basis: Parent reported all six committed blind calibration judgments matched gold before authorizing live-capture review. This reviewer did not read the comparison file.

uncertainties.note: The historical original permits noun-fragment and finite-clause readings; a link-to-links edit alone establishes neither a definite failure nor a definitely necessary correction. It was not regraded or modified here.

limitations: Independently inspected actual frozen-response GFM HTML supplied in the renderer artifact, including exact code text and complete quotations inside uninterrupted strong elements. This establishes those GFM assertions only; no native ChatGPT/Codex UI, CSS, clipboard, or soft-wrapping proof is claimed.

These are known synthetic regression cases captured through independent-agent CLI simulation, not a holdout or intended-host acceptance. Installed-plugin activation, actual ChatGPT Instant, clipboard, soft wrapping, and portal scans were not tested.
This review independently computes final word budgets and fence safety from frozen strings. It does not inspect generator counting traces or establish the timing/execution of generator checks.

Read access was confined to assigned capture records, their bound snapshots, the fragment rubric, the earlier assigned blind calibration material, and the separately authorized actual GFM renderer artifact. No source responses or repository files were changed.
